_comment: Regression thresholds for scripts/live_eval report/gate. Every entry carries its rationale. A change beyond a threshold is REGRESSION only when it is also significant with at least min_samples runs per side (pass rate and citing fraction: one-sided Fisher exact p < alpha; continuous metrics: one-sided Mann-Whitney U p < alpha_continuous); otherwise WATCH. The gate also fails on a pass-rate or citing-fraction WATCH.

min_samples.rationale: Below three runs per side a single flaky run swings a mean by a third or more; qwen38 on this endpoint showed 2x wall variance between identical runs. It also gates the pass-rate floors: a floor is judged only with >= min_samples runs.

alpha.rationale: One-sided Fisher exact test on pass/fail counts. 0.1, not 0.05: at N=5 per side only a 5/5 -> 1/5 drop reaches 0.05, and a release gate that cannot see a 5/5 -> 2/5 drop is useless.

pass_rate_drop.rationale: One run in four newly failing is the smallest drop worth a human look at N=4..8.

wall_p50_increase_ratio.rationale: p50 wall more than 1.5x the previous commit. Smaller moves are within the endpoint's load-driven latency spread (shared 8-slot server).

tokens_p50_increase_ratio.rationale: Token spend is less noisy than wall (no queueing), but tool-choice variance still moves it +-30% run to run.

recall_drop.rationale: review-planted has 8 bugs; 0.2 is losing ~2 of them on average, beyond the one-bug wobble between identical runs.

false_findings_increase.rationale: Mean false findings per run up by two or more: the reviewer started reporting noise, which is the top complaint for repository review.

coverage_drop_points.rationale: Review coverage (percent of relevant lines read) down 10 points or more: reading less of the repo is the failure mode the coverage gate exists to stop.

intervention_rate_increase.rationale: Interventions (nudges, refusals, gate blocks) per turn up by 0.1: the harness is steering one extra turn in ten.

floor_pass_rate.rationale: Absolute floors: independent of the baseline, so a first release or an already-bad baseline cannot ship below them. A floor FAILS only when there are >= min_samples runs and the upper end of the 95% Wilson interval is below it (0/5 fails 0.5; 0/3 does not: 3 runs cannot show a 0.5 scenario is below 0.5). Listed only for scenarios whose floor the current release meets; review-slugify/edit-tests/c24 get floors once their baseline is measured.

alpha_continuous.rationale: One-sided Mann-Whitney U on per-run values. The external review (0.9.4) resampled recorded walls: a bare 1.5x-median threshold at n=3 flagged review-slugify 25% and review-planted 10% of the time with no change. At n=3 per side p=0.05 needs complete separation of the two samples; more samples lower the bar.

citations_wrong_rate_increase.rationale: Mean per-run wrong/checked citation rate up by 5 points, over runs that produced citations (n = citing runs). A rate, not a count: 3 wrong of 44 and 3 wrong of 5 are different failures. A drop in the share of runs that cite at all is flagged separately (citing fraction, Fisher), so a candidate cannot pass by citing nothing.
